simulation.conditioning: 0 < whole-population AF of the original focal allele < 1 at present, for selected and neutral.
simulation.selection_rule: Previous verified survivors, then completed slots in fixed stratum/slot order. An incomplete slot stops the reportable prefix; exhausted slots count as completed without a retained simulation.
simulation.neutral_gate: Existing selected-cohort absorbing-state rejection gate with s=0; no neutral allele relabeling.
simulation.founder_design: Each missing replicate slot receives an independent msprime founder genealogy. Only forward history is retried within that slot. At most one retained simulation per founder.
simulation.independence_basis: One initial focal heterozygote; no other fitness mutations; fixed demographic schedule. Pre-mutation genealogy does not enter focal fitness or survival probability.

p_definition: (1 + reference values >= query) / (n_reference + 1), strict p < alpha; own-origin, mutation-age-matched survivor null.
interpretation: Any-time detection at the focal site uses pointwise tests, not scan-wide calibrated power. No independent de novo FPR cohort.
